allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "=== versions presentes dans le dossier Chrome ==="; Get-ChildItem "$env:ProgramFiles\\Google\\Chrome\\Application" -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\\d+\\.' } | Select-Object Name, LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output "=== new_chrome.exe \(mise a jour en attente\) ==="; $nc = "$env:ProgramFiles\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\new_chrome.exe"; if \(Test-Path $nc\) { Write-Output "PRESENT - mise a jour telechargee, attend un redemarrage de Chrome"; \(Get-Item $nc\).VersionInfo.ProductVersion } else { Write-Output "absent" })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== process Chrome / chromedriver en cours ==="; $p = Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -in @\('chrome','chromedriver','undetected_chromedriver'\) }; if \($p\) { $p | Group-Object ProcessName | Select-Object Name, Count | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { Write-Output "aucun" })

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== version de Chrome ==="; \(Get-Item "$env:ProgramFiles\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\chrome.exe"\).VersionInfo.ProductVersion; Write-Output "=== mise a jour encore en attente ? ==="; if \(Test-Path "$env:ProgramFiles\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\new_chrome.exe"\) { Write-Output "OUI - new_chrome.exe toujours present" } else { Write-Output "NON - la bascule a eu lieu" }; Write-Output "=== dossiers de version ==="; Get-ChildItem "$env:ProgramFiles\\Google\\Chrome\\Application" -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\\d+\\.' } | Select-Object Name | Format-Table -AutoSize)
